Name: Mother's Flowers
Author: TntDove
Description:
A very small mod that simply adds a small basket of flowers that can be seen as decorations at the Flower Dance festival as purchasable decoration.
Buy it from Pierre at the Flower Dance Festival for 150 gold each.

Thank you to my mom who said she wished that she could use this basket of flowers as decoration.

Manifest.Name: Mother's Flowers
Manifest.Description: Adds the small little flower basket found at the Flower Dance as a placeable object. (Because my mom said she wished she could decorate with them.)
Manifest.Author: TntDove
